title: Program Director, Social Welfare & Energy Poverty
about: Program Director at Caritas Baden-Württemberg, overseeing the organisation's energy poverty relief and family support programmes across the region. With over 15 years of experience in social welfare, I coordinate a team of 60 social workers and lead fundraising partnerships with donors including LBBW. My focus is ensuring that no family in Baden-Württemberg faces the choice between heating and eating.

title: Head of Emergency Relief Operations
about: Head of Emergency Relief at Caritas Baden-Württemberg, coordinating the organisation's network of crisis shelters, emergency food services, and rapid response teams. My work focuses on ensuring that people in acute crisis receive dignified, professional support within hours of reaching out. I oversee the deployment of donor funds from LBBW Legato to verified emergency cases with full financial transparency.

title: Head of West Africa Programmes
about: Head of West Africa Programmes at Deutsche Welthungerhilfe, based between Bonn and Ouagadougou. I oversee school feeding, agricultural resilience, and clean water projects across Niger, Burkina Faso, and Mali. With a background in agricultural economics, I focus on designing programmes that create lasting structural change rather than short-term relief.

title: Policy Director, Climate Justice
about: Policy Director at Deutsche Welthungerhilfe, leading the organisation's engagement with UN climate negotiations and the German federal government. I represent the perspectives of communities most affected by climate change in parliamentary hearings, international forums, and media debates. My work connects on-the-ground programme evidence with systemic policy change.

title: Head of Environmental Education & Citizen Engagement
about: Head of Environmental Education at NABU Naturschutzbund Deutschland, developing programmes that connect people of all backgrounds with nature and inspire conservation action. I design citizen science projects, nature discovery trails, and school programmes that reach over 500,000 people annually across Germany.

title: Head of Freshwater Conservation
about: Head of Freshwater Conservation at NABU, leading Germany's largest river rewilding programme. I work with federal and state water authorities, fisheries associations, and local communities to restore natural river dynamics and remove barriers to fish migration. My team has successfully reopened over 800 km of river habitat for migratory fish since 2018.

title: Head of Inclusive Infrastructure Grants
about: Head of Inclusive Infrastructure Grants at Aktion Mensch, overseeing the organisation's multi-million-euro annual grant programme for accessible playground and public space renovation across Germany. I work with municipalities, architects, and disability advocates to ensure every project genuinely meets the needs of disabled people. My team reviews over 2,000 project applications per year.

title: Programme Lead, Arts & Social Inclusion
about: Programme Lead for Arts and Inclusion at Aktion Mensch, commissioning and evaluating creative therapy programmes in care settings across Germany. I work with artists, care home directors, and clinical researchers to ensure our programmes meet both the emotional needs of participants and the professional standards of therapeutic practice.

title: Head of First Aid & Public Health Training
about: Head of First Aid Training at Deutsches Rotes Kreuz, responsible for the national programme that trains schoolchildren, workplace teams, and community volunteers in life-saving skills. Germany has some of the lowest bystander CPR rates in Europe; I lead the national campaign to change this. We aim to train one million new first-aiders annually through partnerships with schools and employers.

title: Head of Psychosocial Crisis Response
about: Head of Psychosocial Crisis Response at Deutsches Rotes Kreuz, coordinating the deployment of trained psychosocial support teams following disasters across Germany and internationally. The psychological aftermath of flooding, fire, and other crises can last years; my team ensures survivors receive timely, evidence-based mental health support. I led the DRK's response after the 2021 Ahr valley floods.

title: Head of Child Protection Programmes
about: Head of Child Protection Programmes at SOS-Kinderdorf Deutschland, overseeing the organisation's anti-trafficking, legal advocacy, and child safeguarding initiatives across Southeast Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa. I work closely with governments, law enforcement, and community leaders to strengthen child protection systems from the ground up.

title: Head of Care Leavers' Support Programme
Medical Director, Germany Operations
about: Medical Director of Ärzte der Welt Germany, overseeing the mobile medical programmes serving homeless, undocumented, and marginalised populations in Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, and Frankfurt. Trained as a general practitioner and public health specialist, I coordinate a network of 200 volunteer physicians and ensure clinical quality standards across all mobile units.

title: Head of Legal Aid & Migrants' Rights
about: Head of Legal Aid and Migrants' Rights at Ärzte der Welt, ensuring that the most legally precarious members of society can access both healthcare and justice without fear. I work with pro bono lawyers, NGO legal clinics, and government ministries to identify and remove systemic barriers faced by undocumented migrants and asylum seekers in Germany, France, and Spain.

title: Head of Carnivore Conservation Programmes
about: Head of Carnivore Conservation at WWF Deutschland, leading the organisation's programmes to protect wolves, bears, and lynx across Central and Eastern Europe. My work bridges ecology, policy, and community engagement, finding pragmatic solutions that allow humans and large predators to share landscapes. I coordinate with rangers, farmers, and national park authorities across seven countries.

title: Head of Marine Protected Areas, Mediterranean
about: Head of Marine Protected Areas at WWF Deutschland, coordinating legal advocacy, patrol operations, and scientific monitoring to strengthen enforcement of Mediterranean MPA regulations. I work with coast guards, fisheries authorities, and scientists across Italy, Spain, and Greece to turn protected areas on paper into genuinely protected habitats. Healthy oceans are essential for both biodiversity and the food security of coastal communities.

title: Head of Refugee Education Integration
about: Head of Refugee Education Integration at Stiftung Bildung, leading the national programme that supports newly arrived refugee children in German schools. My team trains teachers, designs integration curricula, and works with youth welfare offices to ensure no child falls through the cracks. With a background in linguistics and special education, I am convinced that early, high-quality language support is the single most important investment Germany can make in refugee integration.

title: Head of Consumer Rights & Plastics Campaigns
about: Head of Consumer Rights Campaigns at Deutsche Umwelthilfe, leading the organisation's advocacy work on single-use plastics, packaging waste, and sustainable consumption. I design mass-media campaigns, coordinate legal monitoring of retailer compliance, and engage with federal ministries on packaging regulation. My team's campaigns have led to measurable reductions in plastic bag usage and are now being adopted as best practice by EU institutions.
